description: ROM Ali Item Pickup Dispatcher, Inventory Storage, Jewel Upgrades & Full-Bag Audio Rejection

routines.name: ali_item_pickup_dispatcher
routines.purpose: Evaluates item category for $FF1976 (weapons <= 0xC, gems <= 0x10, rank 0x11, spirit jewels <= 0x15, keys <= 0x19, food <= 0x3F)

routines.name: ali_item_consume_sfx_classifier
routines.purpose: Reads classification table 0x05CE56 and dispatches SFX 0x508, 0x50D, 0xC0035F, 0xC00360, 0xC00361

routines.name: ali_chest_collection_bit_recorder
routines.purpose: Sets persistent chest/item collected bit in region bitmasks ($FF0DBC, $FF0E1C, $FF0E2C)

routines.name: ali_weapon_inventory_storage
routines.purpose: Searches 8 weapon slots at $FF0D80; stores item into first free slot or branches to full-bag reject

routines.name: ali_food_inventory_storage
routines.purpose: Searches 16 food/consumable slots at $FF0D90; stores item into first free slot or branches to full-bag reject

routines.name: ali_spirit_jewel_tracker
routines.purpose: Increments spirit jewel level in $FF0DB6 (max 15) and boosts SP capacities by +5

routines.name: ali_gem_key_rank_upgrades
routines.purpose: Increments gem counts in $FF0DB2, sets key bits in $FF0DBA, and computes Ali rank level up (HP = level*2 + 0xC6, SP += 2)

routines.name: ali_full_bag_audio_reject
routines.purpose: Plays full bag error buzzer SFX 0xC00255 with rejection state 0x3C and anim 0x44
